$comment: Maintainer notes, stripped from the merged settings.json by install.sh, never shipped to a user's config.

Payload for the opt-in `sandbox` addition. Enables Claude Code's native OS-level sandbox (sandbox-exec on macOS, bwrap on Linux) so Bash and every other tool run confined, not just the Read tool's own deny rules.

sandbox.filesystem.denyRead is NOT hardcoded here — install.sh computes it at install time from settings.base.json's `Read(<path>)` permission-deny rules (map each to <path>) and injects it, so the Read-tool denylist and the sandbox denylist can never drift apart. See install.sh's sandbox block.

Deliberately narrow: this addition only flips sandbox.enabled on and mirrors the credential denyRead list. It does not set autoAllowBashIfSandboxed and does not touch sandbox.network — those are the operator's call, not this kit's.
